plan_name: Hospital Appointment Booking System MVP Plan

tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database schema with tables for users, doctors, appointments, and notifications
Implement backend API with Node.js/Express for patient registration and JWT authentication
Build appointment scheduling API endpoints with availability checking and booking logic
Design and implement mobile UI screens: Home Dashboard, Doctor Search, and Doctor Profile using React Native
Develop appointment management features: view, reschedule, and cancel appointments with real-time updates
Integrate SendGrid for email notifications and Twilio for SMS reminders
Create User Profile and My Appointments screens with responsive mobile components
Implement doctor profile management API for availability schedules and specialty updates
Build Appointment Booking Confirmation screen with validation and terms acceptance
Set up automated notification triggers for appointment reminders 24 hours before scheduled time
Implement search and filter functionality for doctors by specialty, availability, and ratings
Conduct end-to-end testing of booking flow and deploy MVP to staging environment

risks: Third-party API dependencies (SendGrid, Twilio) may experience downtime affecting notifications
Complex appointment scheduling logic could lead to double-booking if concurrent requests are not handled properly
Mobile UI performance may degrade with large doctor lists without proper pagination and lazy loading
JWT token management and refresh logic could create security vulnerabilities if not implemented correctly
Database query performance may suffer without proper indexing on frequently searched fields like specialty and availability
